title.label: Sad goodbye to a ruined app.

content.label: After years of happy use, im now in search of a new podcast app.  The new update doesnt work for me.  Its too fussy and glitchy.  Episode no longer download seamlessly.   Why?

title.label: App now unusable after latest update

content.label: I used Overcast for years to listen to podcasts but unfortunately the latest update has broken the app. Downloaded episodes disappear or delete halfway through listening, while it no longer accurately tracks what you have and haven’t listened to. Hopefully these issues can be resolved but with no comms from the developed it’s impossible to know what the future holds for Overcast.
Looking forwards to some additional polish. The mechanism to open chapters is very small and close to the progress bar. I do like how it opens full screen now.
Love redesign

This is by far the best podcast player on iOS. I’ve used it daily since it was first released, and I appreciate all the small details and thoughtfulness that have gone into it. 

Smart speed has saved me 412 hours. That’s just impossible to comprehend. 

I was an original “unlock everything forever” or whatever it was called, but I’ve just converted to yearly subscription to hopefully help development continue.

App was great and still is. I’ve been paying to support it for years.
There are some quirks in the UI now but mostly because I was used to how to do certain things for years in the same way. 
One thing that I find annoying is how to set a timer for how long you want the podcast to go on before it stops. Could you bring back the option to set a personalised time? It’s annoying to have to pick between options that don’t fit what I need (either too short or too long). 
But otherwise, it’s great!
5 year premium user, I love the redesign.
Lived this app until the latest update removed the ability to search for and add new podcasts
Feels like a design concept has got in the way of function, data density and relevance
have used for a while and it's the best podcast app i have used to date keep up the good work

I’ve been searching for ages for a simple, clear, easy to use podcast app, all the ones I’ve used seem to have the worst UX imaginable. I thought I’d found the best in Overcast, having had it recommended to me by a friend. Used it for a while, found it generally easy to use and navigate on the move, well easier than the competition. Was just about to commit to the subscription…

Then you had to go and update it. It’s as if you looked at the <deity>-awful UIs of all the others and said “yeah, let’s make ours more like that!”

What a mess, the Home Screen is just a confusing mishmash of elements with no way to identify quickly what is what, and it goes downhill from there, selecting one of the unclear elements on the homepage takes you to other equally confusing pages.

What was a good, clean and easy to navigate interface is lost, shame.

Ignore the poor reviews and give this App a try, you won’t be disappointed.

I’ve been using, and indeed subscribing to Overcast for years, and could never even consider switching to a different Podcast App.

I have absolutely no issues with this latest redesign which retains all of the fantastic features of previous versions in an even faster and slicker package. 

The App is fully functional without a subscription and I only rpay because I feel great software should be supported and rewarded. If you can afford that then you really should consider doing the same.

Five stars, no hesitation.
The new redesign takes some getting used to, but is much better. I use this app every day and would be lost without it.

Needless changes to interface make it more difficult to use.  Features removed why do an update to at makes an app have less features!  Why remove the ability to see how much memory is used by each podcast? Who makes these design choices
I w used overcast everyday for almost 10 years now and it’s still a joy to use. The audio engine sets it apart from the competition. Smart Speed and Voice Boost are 10/10

title.label: A step backwards in many ways

content.label: I get what they are trying to do with the new version of the app, but I honestly find things that used to be easy to control way to hidden now. Like chapters and speed settings that take extra interactions that seem unnecessary to me. It’s still a good podcast app but now I feel annoyed when using it which wasn’t the case before.

title.label: Unusable for me since the update

content.label: Downloads dont seem to work, constantly restarting.  Cant even play podcasts reliably.
Please can you add the option to sort podcast episodes by release date? It’s a nightmare
As an iOS developer I know the work this takes. There are some teething bugs with the rewrite but it’s still a five star app

Marco, venture out of your echo chamber Reddit would be a good place to start - this has been a five-star app for YEARS, but temporarily I have revised to 1. The design change is one thing, but the bugs have rendered the app next to useless for me. Nearly every podcast has a download error, streaming has gone, as has import and export. I'm sure I'll be back and pay again when the mess is sorted.

title.label: Redesigned App is Better Than Ever

content.label:
The redesigned app looks good and feels slick and fast.
Importantly for a podcast app the sound is just as good as ever, best in class.

I have long been a heavy user of Overcast and recommended it to many people. Since the new update I can’t get past the “syncing” screen to access any of my podcasts. Very disappointing.  Please update it again so it works!

title.label: The best podcast app out there

content.label:
Overcast has long been my favourite podcast app. 
I personally love the recent redesign. It makes the app so much faster and cleaner and did not take long to get used to. 

What I love is it has so many features in a simple interface. And the volume boost feature just makes podcasts sound better than any other app out there.

title.label: New look that might have upset people

content.label:
The independent developer has spent most of 2024 re-writing the whole app with the latest frameworks from Apple. 

The old version was getting harder and harder for them to update. So think of this as a fresh start that should get many more updates and features across all the Apple platforms. 

I use this App everyday - it still has the best in class audio features. Automate silence skipping, smart speed, volume boost etc. 

It has weaker playlist and queue support at the moment - but I think we can expect some improvements their soon. 

For anyone leaving ⭐️ reviews - please think is it now that bad? No it’s still the best or have you moved from to another app?

Now looking for a different app. Too much changed too quickly and not tested. Way too many clicks just to play something at night and use the sleep feature. It was reasonably elegant before. Now it’s decided to invent a whole new interaction without checking if it works. White text on blue? In dark mode? In low lighting? Unreadable. And I can’t even guess  due to the interaction pattern no-one knows or can fathom.
I have been using this app for many years and it is far superior than any other I have used

title.label: Was good before but is great now!

content.label: A snappy app with all the features you expect and more!

Features seem to have vanished. My phone storage is full and I can no longer find the option to delete all my podcasts. So I'm forced to delete the entire app and I don't think I will bother reinstalling it.

I downloaded overcast while searching for a podcast player that supports the chapter marks included in some podcasts. It doesn’t work at all. I can’t search for any podcasts and manually adding a podcast also fails. I read from other reviews that a recent release has essentially broken the app for most users.

I have been listening to podcasts since the beginning (yes, I’m older than most of the people reading this!) and Overcast is, in my opinion, the best podcast app out there. Occasionally I try the other apps in this field but always come back to Overcast. No app is perfect but this one works great for me. A recent design refresh has really brought the app up to date visually as well as being reliable, quick and easy to use. Highly recommended!
The best podcast app on the App Store gets even better. It’s so fast and easy to use - and for an app I use every day that’s super important. Thanks Marco!

Good, bold update to arguably the best podcast app.

Small issues like restoring button positions (sleep, play next, etc.) will hopefully come soon.

Losing streaming makes sense on paper with good modern connections — in practice podcast servers are very inconsistent with some very slow, which is painful day to day.

But I’m still with you, Marco!

title.label: I'm sorry but the resdesign is awful,

content.label: I have used Overcast for years happily. The recent redesign and reorganization of how podcasts are displayed has seriously ruined the experience of the app for me. I'm so overwhelmed by all the podcasts and episodes now, instead of the clear way it was displayed before. Why did this need to happen? Can we have the old version back please.

title.label: Not longer usable for me after the revamp

content.label:
I’ve used Overcast for years and loved it, but since the revamp I no longer find it usable. Many of the user interface changes might make sense (even if they take a little getting used to), but the way that podcasts don’t stream, and then don’t seem to download or play in a way that is predictable means that this is a podcast player that doesn’t consistently play podcasts.

I’ve switched to Apple Podcasts, which works fine and plays my podcasts within a couple of seconds of me pressing play.
Looks much slicker and I’m sure it’s quicker too. Great app.

title.label: Update has destroyed a once perfect platform

content.label: The recent update has needlessly ruined this once great app. It’s the only app I use for my podcasts with never issues previously. You know need to go searching for basic functions, you’ve lost podcast synapses which used to be one swipe away on playback, and the requirement to sync and download all podcasts makes everything so slow. Visually it looks nice but usability has disappeared.

title.label: There seems to be no way to export your podcasts

content.label:
There’s a new design now and I think the export podcast function is completely gone. This is annoying as I have over 100 podcasts.

I am going to be changing apps and will have to import them manually.
Was great app but recent updates and rewrites have made it worse from a quality of life point of view. If your new to the app, you won’t be missing anything!

title.label: Some features broken by latest update

content.label:
- deleting podcasts automatically after 24 hours doesn’t work
- Apple Watch app doesn’t update playlists and changing speed doesn’t work

title.label: Latest update wrecks what I loved about the app

content.label:
The latest update has broken the app. 1st: episodes restart downloading from scratch if you navigate away from the downloading page. 2nd: the GUI now forces you to go to a dedicated tab to start downloading an episode, rather than seeing a "+" in a column/list form of all podcasts/episodes. 3rd: finding the actual info box in podcasts is now this hidden thing you click on the logo to find, rather than the previous scheme where you could swipe left/right to access info, or audio settings. This update feels like everything users hate about the worst Windows/OSX updates. I'm on iOS btw.

Edit: I've been so disappointed with how many extra clicks and buttons to navigate in the new app (alongside download issues) that I've switched to Apple Podcasts after a decade using Overcast. RIP.

Loving the re-write, took some getting used too as things moved around but overall a good new user interface.  Still a great app, best podcast player I’ve found and I’ll continue to support and use Overcast.
Really great update, change can be good.
Great clean redesign . You have to keep moving.

Overcast with a new coat. I am using overcast for over 6 years now and the rewrite is a huge step forward in design. 
Keep going forward!

Downloads have sadly become supremely unreliable. Starting a download and switching screens or switching to another app for a moment will start the download from scratch. Sleep timer is now less intuitive and two taps away. Generally everything is more taps than it used to be which kind of negates the code speed improvements.

This app has been doing podcast playing well from day 1. It could not do these things any better however this redesign has achieved what I thought impossible: made the listening even better! Well done Marco, you knocked it out of the park again.

This is by far the best podcast app available on iOS. The latest update has really freaked it up and I love the new aesthetic. My only criticism of it is that the sleep timer is a little hidden now but that is not enough to knock off a star. 5 star app for sure!

title.label: Great app, Smart Speed is awesome

content.label:
Overcast is the best podcasting app out there. I love Smart Speed and Voice Boost, which make lots of podcasts sound much better, and make it easier to listen to stuff more efficiently.

The new design is a great streamlining of the old one. 👏🏻👏🏻
For 10 years the audio playback features have made this the best podcast player in the market. The new version makes the whole thing cleaner and soooo much faster.

title.label: New update a total mess, I’m out of here

content.label: Gone.
